title.text: KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.6 v6 下载提速版已发布
KCL Mobile 1.3.1-kcl.6 v6 speed-up release is out

content.text: KCL Mobile v6（构建号 200056）核心更新：① 下载引擎分片并发提速——大文件（≥4MB）自动探测 Accept-Ranges，按 2MB 切片、2-6 路 Range 连接并行下载再合并校验，client.jar / LWJGL / 整合包下载明显更快；低端机按内存自动降并发，OOM 自动回退单连接，不支持 Range 的源无缝回落，断点续传不受影响；② 崩溃兜底持续加固，杜绝静默闪退；③ 保留 v5 全部修复（PowerVR 渲染器自动切换 / JNA / authlib 401 / 正版登录 / 崩溃日志复制 / 流畅度优化）。请前往官网 https://etc.os.kg/ 或 GitHub Releases 下载更新。

KCL Mobile v6 (build 200056): ① sharded concurrent download engine — files ≥4MB probe Accept-Ranges and are fetched via 2-6 parallel Range connections (2MB slices) then merged and verified; noticeably faster client.jar / LWJGL / modpack downloads; heap-aware concurrency on low-end devices, OOM falls back to single connection, servers without Range support transparently fall back, resume untouched; ② crash handler hardened, no more silent exits; ③ all v5 fixes kept (PowerVR renderer auto-switch / JNA / authlib 401 / premium login / crash-log copy / smoothness). Download at https://etc.os.kg/ or GitHub Releases.
